items.content:
Demonologist: Patch Notes v2.2.0

Hello Demonologists,

A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation area, a new ghost, 120 new sequences, new achievements, gameplay improvements, performance optimizations, audio updates, and much more.

New Content

New Map

Black Platform 13 has been added to the game.

A forgotten train station hidden somewhere between the world of the living and whatever lies beyond it.

Strange things have been reported on the platform. Trains arrive without warning, and some passengers may not be as alive as they appear.

Something is waiting at Platform 13.

The question is...

Super or Natural?

New Ghost

A new ghost has been added to the game.

Some spirits don't attack you directly. They prefer to deceive you.

During your investigation, not everything you see can be trusted. This ghost can make you believe you are following the right path while quietly leading you away from the truth.

Question what you see.

Not everything is as it seems.

New Events

120 new sequences have been added to the game, bringing new paranormal events and unexpected encounters to your investigations.

Gameplay & Systems

Ghost Improvements

  • Fixed an issue where the Iblis ghost could not see players hiding inside closets.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that prevented ghosts from throwing nearby objects during investigations.

    [/*]

Performance & Optimization

Performance Improvements

  • Improved performance drops that could occur when looking at screens and cameras.

    [/*]

  • Various optimization improvements have been implemented.

    [/*]

Visual Improvements

  • Fixed various graphical issues.

    [/*]

  • Various visual improvements have been made across the game.

    [/*]

Audio Improvements

  • ESG audio has been added back to the game.

    [/*]

Communication

Voice Chat Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where players revived through Tarot Cards could not reconnect to voice chat.

    [/*]

User Experience

Audio Settings

  • Fixed an issue where existing audio settings could change when launching the game.

    [/*]

Mute System

  • Fixed an issue where muted players could automatically become unmuted when the game ended.

    [/*]

Achievements

2 new achievements have been added to the game.

The investigation continues...

Watch what you see. Listen to what you hear. And remember, the truth isn't always where you think it is.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

items.content:
Demonologist – Patch Notes v2.1.0

Hello Demonologists,

A new update has arrived, bringing two brand-new investigation areas, over 200 new events, gameplay improvements, communication system updates, optimization work, and much more.

New Content

New Maps

Oakville Street has been added to the game. Built around the atmosphere of Demonologist's earlier investigations, Oakville Street offers a familiar blend of suspense, exploration, and paranormal activity while introducing plenty of new scares to uncover.

Oakville Library has been added to the game. Oakville Library brings a different kind of fear. The vast halls, towering shelves, and eerie silence create a constant sense of unease, making every investigation feel tense from beginning to end.

New Events

More than 200 new sequences have been added across Oakville Street and Oakville Library.

Facility Update

The Snatcher has escaped from the Facility.

New Cosmetics

New outfits have been added and are now available for purchase.

Emote System

A brand-new Emote System has been added.

Gameplay & Systems

Voice Communication Rework

The in-game voice communication system has been updated.

  • Dead players and living players can no longer hear each other.

    [/*]

  • Voice volume now decreases based on player distance.

    [/*]

  • Players who are far enough apart will no longer be able to hear each other at all.

    [/*]

Chat System Rework

The chat system has been updated.

  • Dead and living players now have separate chat channels.

    [/*]

  • Dead players can see messages from both living and dead players.

    [/*]

  • Living players can only see messages from other living players.

    [/*]

Focus System

Fixed an issue that allowed players to move forward and backward while focusing on the screen.

Chromatic Aberration will now automatically be disabled while focusing.

Animations

Animations for several tools have been revised:

  • Hammer

    [/*]

  • Pocket Watch

    [/*]

  • Camera

    [/*]

User Experience

Loading Screen Improvements

The loading screen has been completely revamped both visually and technically.

Players will now encounter different map images during loading regardless of which map they are entering.

Audio Improvements

The walking sound played while crouching has been replaced and its volume has been reduced.

Fixes & Improvements

  • Various visual and design issues have been fixed.

    [/*]

  • Overall game optimization improvements have been implemented.

    [/*]

  • Collision issues on several maps have been resolved.

    [/*]

  • Lighting adjustments have been made on selected maps.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where held items could clip into walls while crouching near surfaces.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue that caused custom control settings to reset after restarting the game.

    [/*]

  • Various localization fixes and improvements have been implemented.

    [/*]

Achievements

New achievements have been added.

The investigation continues...

Explore Oakville, watch your surroundings, and if you hear footsteps in the Library... make sure they're yours.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

Clock Wizard Games

    • No Devourer Today

      [/*]

Localization

    [/*]

Step carefully, trust your instincts… and don’t look back. Share your thoughts and experiences with us. We’re watching. 👁️

Happy Hunting! ❤️ Clock Wizard Games A Note from the Developers

Honestly, this update exists because of you.

Your feedback, clips, streams, bug reports, and even the random late-night messages keep shaping Demonologist more than you might think. We read, we watch, and we take notes — all of it matters.

Cursed Chapel was built with the community in mind: how you move through spaces, how tension builds, and those moments where everything goes wrong in the best way possible.

This isn’t a final version, and it’s definitely not the end. We’ll be closely watching how you play the new map and we’ll keep improving things step by step.

Thanks for sticking with us, scaring yourselves, and being part of this journey.

Clock Wizard Team ❤️

items.title: These terrifyingly fun co-op horror games are perfect to play with friends for Halloween
items.summary: Spooktober is going to be scarier and funnier than ever before.
items.content:
Credit: Source: Steam By Samarveer Singh Published Oct 17, 2025, 7:00 PM EDT Gaming has been Samarveer’s greatest passion, and the Literature graduate in him takes immense joy in dissecting games for their themes, messages, and impact. Samarveer holds a deep appreciation of gaming, and considers the platform to be the most immersive and impactful across all media. He can be found engaging with gaming communities online, always ready to debate the finer points of ray tracing or itching to write an 8-page collegiate thesis on any game that impacts him emotionally. Sign in to your XDA account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap It's Spooktober again, and with Halloween just a couple of weeks out, now is the best time to get your horror game library growing again. Still, what's the point of a good horror game if you can't enjoy it with your friends? After all, the most dire of situations also become insanely hilarious if you've got some friends along, and there's just nothing more rewarding than exploring a haunted setting and hearing your friend scream out from the other end of the hall.

We had some immensely rewarding single-player horror releases this year, but it's honestly the smaller, co-op centric survival-horror experiences where the 'fun' truly lies. That becomes even truer when everyone is on voice chat and trying not to scream their heads off.

Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Close Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-1-1593011275"] = '" Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Close Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam Source: Steam "'; Backrooms lore has enthralled the entire internet for years now, with a fear of liminal spaces and indescribable monsters being at the center of the allure. From endless musty basements to hospital wings full of spider-like creatures ready to devour you, Backrooms games have some of the most fantastic level design, and it all gets better when you have a friend in tow, just as anxious as you are.

Now, there's always Escape the Backrooms on Unreal Engine 4, which is a better, more fleshed-out game with more levels, but there's also Backrooms: Escape Together . A solo-dev project with an incredible amount of polish that only comes with Unreal Engine 5 , Backrooms: Escape Together has a small yet curated list of fantastic levels for you and your friends to be completely lost in.

The visual and sound design, along with the fantastic optimization, and even DLSS 4 support in a solo-dev project are all admirable, and Backrooms: Escape Together presents a wonderful horror adventure with plenty of puzzles for you and your squad to engage in, all while keeping your head on a swivel.

Backrooms: Escape Together Released October 18, 2022 Developer(s) Triiodide Studios Publisher(s) Triiodide Studios Engine Unreal Engine 5 Platform(s) PC Developed on Unreal Engine 5, Backrooms: Escape Together is a co-op survival horror game where you and your friends must explore eerie, endless maze-like levels and work together to escape terrifying entities and madness.

Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Close Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-2-1557484359"] = '" Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Close Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios Credit: Source: Nightmare Studios "'; We've all played Phasmophobia , and frankly, we've heard way too much about it, too. Still, the concept of pure survival-horror with friends that is genuinely scary even when you're with friends? That's gold right there, and Project Unknown delivers exactly that. As members of Paranormal Property Solutions, you and your squad will go to clients' houses that are being haunted by supernatural creatures with terrifying design.

The job? Learn the ghosts' patterns, behaviors, and where they are coming from to exorcise them. Each character you pick will have unique special abilities that will help the squad when picked right, and with the right tools at your disposal, you'll be able to exorcise the spirits that haunt the properties in Project Unknown . The game is even on sale until October 24, meaning you could just as easily pick two copies — one for yourself and one for a friend to try out.

Project Unknown Released October 11, 2025 Developer(s) PsychoRavens Publisher(s) Nightmare Studios An online co-op horror game featuring unique playable characters and RPG mechanics. Exorcise ghosts using your special abilities and tools while surviving the supernatural onslaught. As a gifted member of Paranormal Property Solutions (P.P.S.), you will tackle requests from troubled clients and exorcise the evil spirits haunting their discounted property. Exercise caution as you help clients sell their house ghost-free and secure your well-earned share!

Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Close Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-3-1326479765"] = '" Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Close Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork Source: semiwork "'; Imagine if Phasmophobia had more edge, and what you get from that is R.E.P.O. In this game, you and your squad play as paranormal repossession agents. As ridiculous as it sounds, it's just as much fun. You're tasked with clearing out haunted locations of restless spirits. However, instead of comedy-driven chaos (which you'll still get plenty of), R.E.P.O. leans into genuine fear with its dark visuals and unpredictable hauntings.

Each encounter in the game feels handcrafted to ruin your nerves. The best part? Every single member of the squad has a job to do, which makes teamwork non-negotiable. You're going to find yourself yelling, panicking, and even blaming your own friends for dying... right before instantly queuing up for another round.

R.E.P.O. Like Horror Roguelike Action Stealth Systems Released February 26, 2025 Engine Unity Multiplayer Online Co-Op Number of Players 1-6 players Steam Deck Compatibility Unknown 6 Images Close Where to play Close WHERE TO PLAY DIGITAL Platform(s) PC Genre(s) Horror, Roguelike, Action, Stealth Powered by Expand Collapse Panicore ($5) One monster, five victims, and unlimited screaming panicore-2.jpg panicore-1.jpg panicore-6.jpg panicore-4.jpg panicore-5.jpg Close panicore-2.jpg panicore-1.jpg panicore-6.jpg panicore-4.jpg panicore-5.jpg window.arrayOfGalleries["article-gallery-4-1056034448"] = '" panicore-2.jpg panicore-1.jpg panicore-6.jpg panicore-4.jpg panicore-5.jpg Close panicore-2.jpg panicore-1.jpg panicore-6.jpg panicore-4.jpg panicore-5.jpg "'; Sometimes, all you need is a good old-fashioned "run or die" formula to remind you just how anxiety-inducing things can get in a horror game, and Panicore is a brilliant example of that. In this game, you and your friends are stuck in a dark facility, hunted by an unpredictable monster as you navigate tight corridors and dark paths to find a way out, debating if splitting up to find the right path would be better than sticking together.

Sounds simple enough, right? Except that the game requires your mic to be on at all times, because the unpredictable monster reacts to sound as well. This means that even a small shriek or even a sentence spoken out too loud could get you killed. Sneaking quietly then becomes incredibly important, and any information you share over comms is limited, delivered under the fear of the monster hearing you. The atmosphere is thick, the lighting is perfect, and the sense of helplessness is constant in Panicore .

The single-player games were all about running away from all sorts of monsters and creatures, but The Outlast Trials gives you some options to tool up with your friends, investing in soft abilities that will definitely help you, but don't fool yourself into thinking you could take on the variety of horrors the game will throw at you.

items.content:
Hello Demonologist Community

We are thrilled to introduce a brand-new game developed by our second team, designed specifically for you and your friends to have an absolute blast together!

🔥 Introducing: Night Club Simulator! 🔥

In this game, you and your friends will take on the challenge of transforming a rundown nightclub into the hottest venue in town. But it won’t be easy—you’ll have to manage chaos, deal with rowdy customers, craft unique cocktails, and unlock exciting new upgrades to create the ultimate nightlife experience.

🚀 Play the Free Demo on February 24th!

The game will have a completely free demo available on February 24th, allowing you to experience the nightlife madness with your friends! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist to stay updated on all the latest details.

🔔 Stay Connected on Discord!

We have also updated our Discord channels so you can stay informed about everything related to Night Club Simulator. Make sure to grab the Night Club Simulator Role to receive all the latest news and announcements! While our first team continues to work on Demonologist, our second team has been pouring their passion into this exciting new project. Rest assured, Demonologist will keep receiving updates and improvements, but we wanted to bring you something fresh and equally fun to enjoy. We can't wait to share more details soon! Let us know what you think, and get ready for a wild ride in Night Club Simulator! 🍹🎶🔥
